briefdescription.para: scanFunction - Do the initial scan of the function, building up information about each block.
Insert a new empty MachineBasicBlock with BB as its BasicBlock and insert it after OrigMBB.
Split the basic block containing MI into two blocks, which are joined by an unconditional branch.

detaileddescription.para: Update data structures and renumber blocks to account for this change and returns the newly created block.

briefdescription.para: isBlockInRange - Returns true if the distance between specific MI and specific BB can fit in MI's displacement field.
fixupConditionalBranch - Fix up a conditional branch whose destination is too far away to fit in its displacement field.

detaileddescription.para: It is converted to an inverse conditional branch + an unconditional branch to the destination.

briefdescription.para: computeBlockSize - Compute the size for MBB.
getInstrOffset - Return the current offset of the specified machine instruction from the start of the function.

detaileddescription.para: This offset changes as stuff is moved around inside the function.

briefdescription.para: print block size and offset information - debugging
verify - check BBOffsets, BBSizes, alignment of islands
runOnMachineFunction - This method must be overloaded to perform the desired machine code transformation or analysis.
getPassName - Return a nice clean name for a pass.

detaileddescription.para: This usually implemented in terms of the name that is registered by one of the Registration templates, but can be overloaded directly.
